headlines.headline: Texas Tech, Nebraska land marquee 2026 commits as Tennessee's Ralph Scott faces season-ending knee surgery
headlines.detail: Four-star PG Aaron Britt Jr. committed to Texas Tech as Grant McCasland's first pledge of the cycle; Fred Hoiberg landed the highest-ranked recruit in Nebraska history in four-star forward Dawson Battie; Tennessee freshman Ralph Scott is set for knee surgery that will sideline him at least six months.

headlines.headline: Pistons bump Jalen Duren offer to $200M as Bucks emerge as new suitor, no deal at Media Days' opening
headlines.detail: Detroit raised its extension offer to five years, $200 million, up from $190 million, but Duren is still seeking closer to his $287M Rose Rule max; Milwaukee has joined Sacramento as a reported trade suitor as the Rockets and Mavericks kick off 2026-27 Media Days.

headlines.headline: Bears' QB room depletes as Caleb Williams, Tyson Bagent both uncertain for Monday vs. Eagles
headlines.detail: Chicago could turn to Case Keenum against Philadelphia with Williams (hamstring) and Bagent (concussion) in question; Atlanta confirmed Michael Penix Jr. starts Week 3 vs. Green Bay; the Rams' Matthew Stafford threw four TDs, two to Davante Adams, in a Monday-night rout of the Giants.

headlines.headline: Texas Tech doubles down on transfer spending after Big 12 title as Miami's $10M Mensah bet headlines portal arms race
headlines.detail: Fresh off a Big 12 title and CFP semifinal run, Texas Tech assembled another elite transfer class to defend its title, part of a broader spending arms race that includes Miami's reported $10 million NIL deal for transfer QB Darian Mensah, the portal's top-ranked signal-caller this cycle.
